<CarlBeek> - 👍 docker it is
- what would the purpose of an nginx middleware be?
- I’ll deploy sqlite as a container for extra portability then
- ill overwrite the defaults (with default values) in the dockerfile 
- warn would be ok, but log level options are v, vv, vvv, etc
- i’m aware of what prometheus does, just not what it is doing in this particular case. i can’t seem to find any collection of metrics in the code, so i get the feeling the prometheus option is just a stub.
